svg.title: Selected association estimates: primary, clinical and external limits
svg.desc: Stored patient-level aggregate effects and intervals. Median differences and adjusted mean differences appear in separate panels. The complete results register retains every aggregate analysis; no cohorts are pooled.
svg.text: Immune balance: association and its limits
Selected summaries only. Positive, inconclusive and opposing estimates shown together; no clinical prediction claim.
A. Primary and response-definition sensitivity: median R-minus-NR differences
Selection history, mixed response definitions and recovery dependence.
Same cohort; more uniform outcome subset is small and inconclusive.
B. Separate external sensitivities: non-equivalent median group differences
Smart-seq2 and different labels; outcome definition/timing unresolved.
L097 Schlenker: broad CD8, R+TF vs PD
Different outcome groups/denominator; opposing but inconclusive.
C. Adjusted means: secondary/exploratory OLS effects, not the primary median estimand
Sparse yield overlap; extrapolation; not causal adjustment.
Sparse regimen overlap and residual confounding; Holm-seven family.
Sparse regimen overlap; no independence-from-treatment claim.
All intervals are stored 95% intervals: patient-percentile bootstrap for medians/AUC; HC3 normal approximation for adjusted means. Means and medians cannot be directly
subtracted to quantify attenuation. The rank-test p-value is not an inversion of the bootstrap interval.
Small retrospective patient cohorts; labels and denominators differ; clinical adjustment is limited. AUC is same-cohort rank separation, not validated accuracy. No pooling,
causal/mechanistic or confirmatory biomarker claim. See docs/FIGURE_CAPTIONS.md and docs/REFERENCES.md. Aggregate reuse review
